artifact.name: crm_send_inactive_messages
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- Defensive defaults so we never pass nil into tools
    local segment: string = input.segment or ""
    local inactive_days: number = input.inactive_days or 0

    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}
    local sends: number = 0
    local MAX_SENDS: number = 10

    -- Fetch customers
    local list = tools.crm.list({ segment = segment })
    if list == nil or type(list) ~= "table" then
        return { error = "unknown_error", message = "crm.list returned nil or non-table" }
    end

    -- Check for tool-level error first (per tool contract)
    if not list.ok then
        return { error = list.error, message = list.message }
    end

    local customers = list.customers or {}

    for i = 1, #customers do
        if sends >= MAX_SENDS then
            break
        end
        local cust: CustomerRef = customers[i]
        -- guard fields
        local id = cust.id
        local name = cust.name or ""
        local last_seen = cust.last_seen_days or 0
        if last_seen >= inactive_days then
            local text = string.format("Hi %s, we miss you!", name)
            local r = tools.message.send({ user = id, text = text })
            if r == nil or type(r) ~= "table" then
                table.insert(failed, id)
            else
                -- Check for tool-level error by inspecting 'ok'
                if not r.ok then
                    table.insert(failed, id)
                else
                    table.insert(notified, id)
                end
            end
            sends += 1
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: List customers of a segment and message inactive ones up to 10 sends.
